rows.source: Transfer 80 uL washed GFP-expressing microbial-cell suspension containing 100000 cells and 80 uL 2x lysis buffer into the lysis tube.
Mix the lysis mixture by pipetting 10 times.
Incubate the lysis mixture at 37 C for 30 min.
Centrifuge the lysate at 12000 x g and 22 C for 10 min to resolve a clarified supernatant fraction and a debris-pellet fraction.
Transfer 100 uL clarified supernatant fraction to the clarified-lysate output tube.
Record a fluorescence readout from the clarified lysate.
